summary: Tracy Franz works in Buddhist studies and other fields. Attested in 2018, she held teaching posts at Dalhousie University and Shokei University, where she was an English teacher.

Travis L. Smith is a scholar of Indology and religious studies. He studied at UC Berkeley under Vasudha Dalmia and Robert and Sally Goldman, and earned his PhD at Columbia under John Stratton Hawley in 2007. He held posts at Barnard and Florida.
Trent Walker is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. He earned his PhD at the University of California, Berkeley, where his doctoral supervisor was Alexander von Rospatt.

Trevor Leggett (1914–2000) worked in Japanology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied law at King's College London circa 1931–1934 and served as Head of the Japanese Service at the BBC from circa 1946 to 1970.

Trijang Rinpoche (1901–1981) was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under Sherab Gyatso. He taught at Ganden Shartse Monastery; his students included the 14th Dalai Lama, Zong Rinpoche, and Thubten Yeshe.

Troy Organ (1912–1992) was a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied at the University of Iowa (~1939–1941). He held positions at Parsons College (~1944–1945), Chatham University (~1945–1946), the University of Akron (~1946–1954), and Ohio University (1954).
Trung Huynh is a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies. He completed a PhD at the University of the West under doctoral supervisor Darui Long, attested in 2016.

Trungram Gyaltrul Rinpoche (1968–) is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He completed his PhD at Harvard University (~1997–2004), where he studied with Thomas Burke and doctoral supervisor Leonard van der Kuijp.

Tse-fu Kuan is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a doctorate at the University of Oxford in 2004 under Richard Gombrich. He later held a postdoctoral research post at National Cheng Kung University and a position at Yuan Ze University.

Tsering Dhundup Gonkatsang (1951–) works in Tibetology and linguistics. Educated at Panjab University, Tibetan Children's Village, and the University of Glasgow, he served as headmaster at Tibetan Children's Village and became Instructor in Tibetan at the University of Oxford in 2001.
Tsering Gyaltsen is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and was traditionally trained under Dudjom Rinpoche.

Tsering Shakya (1959–) is a scholar of Tibetology and history/archaeology. He studied at SOAS University of London (~1978–1981), where he later held an academic post (~1990–2005), and became a professor at the University of British Columbia (~2005).

Tsoknyi Rinpoche (1966–) is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure. He studied under Nyoshul Khenpo Jamyang Dorje, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, and Adeu Rinpoche, and taught Adam Pearcey.

Tsuguhito Takeuchi (1951–2021) was a linguist and Tibetologist. Educated at Kyoto, Penn, and Indiana under scholars including Beckwith, Nishida, and Hoffmann, he served as Professor of Linguistics at Kobe City University of Foreign Studies (~1994–2017).

Tsugunari Kubo (1936–2019) was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at the University of Tokyo (~1956–1967). He lectured at Rissho University and served as president of Reiyūkai and the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.
Tsui Lan Liza Cheung is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned her PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2013). She studied under Toshiichi Endo and doctoral supervisor K. L. Dhammajoti.

Tsukasa Mizushima (1952–) is a scholar of Indology and history/archaeology. He studied at Toyama Chubu High School (~1968–1971) and held academic posts at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies (~1984–1997) and the University of Tokyo (~1997–2018).

Tsultrim Allione (1947–) is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure who earned a master's degree at Antioch University (~1982–1984). She studied under Abo Rinpoche, Chögyam Trungpa, and Namkhai Norbu, and founded Tara Mandala.

Tsultrim Gyatso is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He served as a senior instructor at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies and as Abbot of Drepung Gomang Dratsang (attested 1987).

Tsultrim Kelsang (1939–) is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He held posts at the International Buddhist Association (attested 1973), Otani University (attested 1984 as lecturer, 1999–2002 as professor), and Ryukoku University (2015).
